##### Project general facts

Altair 52 by Acube Abodes Realty is a low-rise residential building that brings resort-style living to a calm, community-focused setting. Clean architectural lines create a refined silhouette, while thoughtful exterior lighting gives the facade a striking presence after dark. The building rises from a ground floor to four residential levels and a rooftop amenity deck. The collection offers studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments, with selected two-bedroom layouts including a private study for working from home.

A full-floor clubhouse and amenity hub sits at the heart of the project. Residents can enjoy an infinity pool and a children's pool, a modern gym, an outdoor fitness area and a yoga deck, as well as a jogging track and a rock-climbing wall. A mini golf course, a Zen garden, an outdoor cinema, a co-working space, a children's play area and a pet-friendly corner add variety, while a rooftop lounge with cabanas and dedicated barbecue areas creates an inviting social setting.

Interiors combine quality and warmth, with decorative stone panels, textured paint and elegant lighting in the living areas. Kitchens are fitted with premium German appliances, and bathrooms feature textured tiles, wood veneer and mirrors, while a smart home system makes daily living more efficient. Spacious balconies extend the living space outdoors, and homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai South is a large master-planned district built around Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai, combining residential neighbourhoods, logistics and business zones, schools and leisure facilities. Wide streets, parks, cycling paths and community retail create a calm, family-friendly environment, while the district's role as an aviation and logistics hub brings a steady flow of employers and professionals to the area.

Emirates Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Sheikh Zayed Road connect residents with the wider city and the neighbouring emirates. Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai are a short drive away, while Palm Jebel Ali, Dubai Marina and Downtown Dubai are within comfortable reach, and Abu Dhabi is easily accessible by road. Schools, clinics and supermarkets serve families across the surrounding communities.

Dubai South is a freehold area open to international buyers and one of the key growth corridors of Dubai. The expansion of Al Maktoum International Airport and the development of Expo City Dubai support strong demand from professionals working in aviation, logistics and business. Competitive entry prices, resort-style amenities and a growing residential community underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners and investors.
